remediation_plan.root_cause_analysis: Clinical EHR documentation establishes valid medical indications (E11.9), but claim intake crosswalk mistakenly listed non-qualifying code (E11.9), triggering adverse benefit determination CO-16.
required_evidence_criteria: Extract direct clinical quotations of physician Dr. Evelyn Zhao's objective findings.
Cite qualifying diagnostic code (E11.9) and applicable coverage policies.
Invoke federal ERISA 29 CFR § 2560.503-1 / ACA § 2719 statutory appeal review standards.
Demand immediate claim overturn and re-adjudication.

FORMAL STATUTORY APPEAL FOR CLAIM RE-ADJUDICATION
Date: 2026-01-20
To: Appeals & Grievance Department, UnitedHealthcare Commercial
Re: Formal First-Level Statutory Appeal against Denial of Claim CLM-44820-B
Patient: Arthur Pendelton | DOB: N/A
Member ID: UHC-9938210 | Date of Service: 2026-01-20
Disputed Service: CPT 99244 | Disputed Denial Code: CO-16
Claim Amount: $580.0

1. STATEMENT OF DISPUTE
This letter constitutes a timely, formal appeal pursuant to 29 U.S.C. § 1133 and 29 C.F.R. § 2560.503-1 disputing the adverse benefit determination issued for CPT 99244. The denial under code CO-16 is erroneous and contrary to clinical record proof and established coverage guidelines.

2. CLINICAL FACTUAL SUBSTANTIATION & DIRECT EHR EVIDENCE
The medical record clearly establishes that the disputed service was medically necessary and fully indicated.
Treating Physician Documentation:
"ASSESSMENT & PLAN: 1. Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus with uncontrolled hyperglycemia (ICD-10: E11.69 / E11.9). 2. Diabetic peripheral neuropathy (ICD-10: E11.40). 3. Initiated basal insulin glargine 14 units nightly; titrated metformin to 1000 mg BID. 4. Prescribed continuous glucose monitor (Dexcom G7) a"
Verbatim Clinical Findings:
- Acute presentation documented by Dr. Evelyn Zhao.
- Primary diagnostic indication: E11.9.
- Secondary baseline complaint (E11.9) was erroneously billed as primary reason for service during registration intake.

3. STATUTORY & CODING CROSSWALK JUSTIFICATION
Under CMS Guidelines and ERISA regulations:
- Primary Qualifying Diagnosis: ICD-10 E11.9
- Procedure: CPT 99244
- Statutory Precedent: ERISA 29 C.F.R. § 2560.503-1(h)(2) requires a full and fair review taking into account all comments, documents, and records submitted.

4. DEMAND FOR REMEDY
We respectfully demand that UnitedHealthcare Commercial overturn this adverse determination immediately and process CPT 99244 for full contractual payment within 30 statutory days.
